about: DevOps & AI engineer who automates everything worth automating. I design cloud infrastructure, ship agentic tools with guardrails, and teach the next generation of engineers, from 7-year-olds to working professionals.
bio: I sit where platform engineering meets AI: automating the boring parts, building agents with real guardrails, and teaching others to do the same.

services.title: DevOps & Platform
services.text: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and cost-optimized AWS architectures.

services.title: AI & Agentic Systems
services.text: Production agents with policy enforcement, approvals, audit trails and rollback, plus RAG, tool calling and MCP integrations.

services.title: Teaching & Mentorship
services.text: Cohort-based curricula for Kubernetes, DevSecOps and agentic AI engineering, including courses designed for kids and teens.

experience.title: Engineer III
experience.description: Infrastructure as code with Terraform and CI/CD with AWS CodePipeline. Docker deployments and AWS Glue data workflows across S3, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, ECR, DMS, Athena and Lake Formation. Python data pipelines with Great Expectations on Airflow, cost-saving migrations to S3, AWS Transfer Family with SSO, and AI-powered tools built on Flask, refine.dev, Ollama, Azure AI and Amazon Bedrock for Alation.

experience.title: IS System Analyst
experience.description: Punch-out mapping and organization setup, resolving stuck order transmissions, and supporting B2B and B2C systems in Jira sprints. Load testing, centralized logging with the ELK stack, and application deployments on Kubernetes.
